before: East Asian and Latin-letter or digit boundaries use their natural text advances.
after: Supported East Asian-to-Latin or digit boundaries use one quarter of the East Asian font size. Reverse boundaries use only the authored font metric unless paragraph properties disable them.
reason: Only derived layout changes. Shared nodes, canonical UTF-16 offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged. The metric port is internal and session-local. No public measurer method or document operation is added.
